intro: UX research entails a blend of planning, participant recruitment, data collection, and the often difficult task of synthesizing qualitative findings into actionable insights. blocks.text: What does UX research entail in daily practice

When you ask what does UX research entail, the answer spans far beyond just talking to users. It is a cycle of discovery and evidence building. You spend roughly 40 percent of your time on practical tasks like scoping and analysis. The rest of your week is often consumed by administrative overhead, such as scheduling, consent management, and stakeholder communication.
The challenge of qualitative data synthesis

Synthesis is the act of turning raw, non-linear data into a coherent story. You might have 20 hours of video recordings and dozens of pages of notes. The goal is to identify patterns without letting your own assumptions take over. This is where many researchers struggle. It is mentally draining work that requires deep focus.

items: Cognitive overload from processing massive amounts of unstructured data.
The risk of confirmation bias when looking for specific answers.
Lack of standardized documentation paths between different research projects.
Fragmented workflows across multiple apps like Zoom, Notion, and Figma.

blocks.text: Practical ways to fix your synthesis workflow

You do not need expensive software to improve your process. Start by adopting a structured framework. Affinity diagramming is a classic for a reason. Use post-it notes in FigJam to group observations into themes. This physical or digital sorting forces you to reconcile disparate data points.

Collaborate early. Invite stakeholders to watch sessions or participate in synthesis workshops. When you work in a silo, your personal bias grows. Team synthesis sessions help you validate your findings against other perspectives.

Lazur helps you manage your Mac research environment. If you are buried in tabs, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to summarize a research paper or a long transcript open in your browser. It provides a quick report so you can focus on the next step.
Divide your week to protect your focus time. Use your mornings for deep synthesis work when your brain is fresh. Save the administrative tasks like scheduling and email for the afternoon.

faq.question: What does UX research entail for a solo researcher?
faq.answer: It entails wearing many hats, from recruiter to analyst. You must balance the time spent on administrative tasks with the deep focus required for qualitative synthesis.

faq.question: Why is qualitative data synthesis so time-consuming?
faq.answer: It requires identifying patterns across unstructured data, managing cognitive bias, and ensuring your findings are objective and actionable for stakeholders.
